records.subject: Dual-network binary-solvent thermogalvanic polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel fiber
records.object: Fiber diameter 500 micrometers and length 30 mm
records.quote: Here, we present a self-powered in-nostril hydrogel sensor for long-term non-irritant anti-interference respiratory monitoring, which is developed from a dual-network binary-solvent thermogalvanic polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel fiber (d = 500 mu m, L=30 mm) with Fe2+/Fe3+ ions serving as a redox couple, which can generate a thermoelectrical signal in the nasal cavity based on the temperature difference between the exhaled gas and skin as well as avoid interference from the external environment.
